title: Map: The Battle of Badr (ghazwah)

paras.en: Key to the routes: the route of Abu Sufyan’s trade caravan; the route of the army of the polytheists; the route of the Islamic army. Scale: miles.
paras.ur: راستے کی علامات: ابو سفیان کے تجارتی قافلے کا راستہ؛ مشرکین کے لشکر کا راستہ؛ اسلامی لشکر کا راستہ۔ پیمانہ: میل۔
paras.ps: د لارو نښې: د ابوسفیان د سوداګریز کاروان لار؛ د مشرکینو د لښکر لار؛ د اسلامي لښکر لار. پېمانه: مایل.

sourceNote: Printed page 51: a full-page plan titled “غزوۂ بدر” with the labels “ابو سفیان”, “اسلامی لشکر کی روانگی”, “مشرکین کا لشکر”, a key of three routes (the route of Abu Sufyan’s trade caravan, the route of the army of the polytheists, the route of the Islamic army), a scale in miles and contour lines. It is redrawn only as a schematic plan; the contour lines and small place names are not reproduced. A handwritten note in the upper right and a thumb at the lower edge are excluded. English and Pashto are our translations (need native review); watermark, handwriting, page-edge shadows, a thumb at the page edge and ornamental borders excluded. Scan n = printed page n+1 (file = {p//2:03d}_page_2 for even printed page p, {(p-1)//2:03d}_page_1 for odd p).
